reviews_captured_by_me.text: Liam and his apprentice Chayse constructed a beautiful shower for us. High quality workmanship and top notch work ethic. Liam also provides excellent input/ideas. Project progressed as anticipated and finished as planned. I would highly recommend Liam to anyone!

We were so impressed with Turnmire Eco Construction!  They did a tile bathroom remodel for us and it turned out beautifully:) They also finished our attic and added a staircase, … and then helped us redo a small bathroom with shower.  Liam is a great communicator and very thorough in his work.  These guys were hanging around for months and we actually kind of miss them.  Highly recommend! If we have any more projects come up, Liam will be my first call :)
